3461.title: Stored event metadata redirects provider identity
3461.rootCauseOneLine: The resume selector accepts the newest provider ID from any event, without checking event authority or cross-thread ownership.

prReviews.topFinding: Runtime ownership guards do not change server event-based identity selection.

3461.proposedFix: Define authoritative identity transitions and validate provider identity ownership at acceptance and dispatch.
3461.caveats: Database reproduction repeated in two clean checkouts; live Codex incident and writer lock were not replayed. No fix PR because open PR 3460 links the issue.
